content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple has released new silicone and TechWoven series, with colors matching the phone, plus our top picks from third-party brands we've used for years. From new wine red models with built-in stands, ultra-grippy customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods. We also have super affordable options starting at $14 from budget brands like Spigen.

Best iPhone 18 Pro cases

Updated 9/27: Added exclusive discount codes for 9to5 readers.

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Mulberry: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Light Blue: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Navy Blue: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Case with MagSafe — Black: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Taupe: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Black: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Black: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Case with MagSafe — Mulberry: $59

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe — Magenta: $49
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Case with MagSafe — Wine Red: $49

Featured Brand: ESR

ESR's brand new iPhone 18 Pro case and accessory lineup is officially here, featuring premium color craftsmanship, patented technology and more highlights. The star of this new collection is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather magnetic case, featuring a built-in zinc alloy Flex stand hidden within the camera module protection area, offering 3x military-grade protection, and a "soft, flexible, comfortable grip." Like other accessories, the new Atelier also comes in four color options, perfectly complementing the new wine red, glacial, black and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (Grip Version) $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is the gold standard, with all flagship models now available for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year also introduces the brand new Rugged Case series, each color featuring topographic patterns from Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Brand: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to launch its timeless Grip case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond the usual clean design and ultra-grippy texture, you can continue to customize your style with a wide range of body skins, and there's a discount when purchased with a compatible Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable, drop protection, ultra-grippy texture, crisp button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 Screen Protector (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy install, auto-alignment, fully dust-proof

Dbrand also launches the new MNML brand case series this year, starting from $39, featuring simple and sleek designs, more affordable pricing, MagSafe support, while maintaining the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy Blue, Tan, Wine Red

Spigen

  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro) Black: $14 (originally $18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro) Clear: $13 (originally $17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro) Black: $20 (originally $22)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max) Black: $14 (originally $18)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max) Clear: $13 (originally $17)
  • Spigen Nano Pop MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max) Wine Red: $21 (originally $24)
  • Spigen Slim Armor MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro) Black: $26 (originally $50)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro) Blue: $19 (originally $40)
  • Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case (iPhone 17/18 Pro Max) Black: $19 (originally $40)

SANDMARC

  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro) $54 (originally $60) Use code 9TO510 at checkout
  • SANDMARC Pro Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro Max) $54 (originally $60)

****Note: SANDMARC products traditionally only go on sale once per year... unless you use our exclusive discount code.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small shop that started in Texas, USA, making some of the best leather cases on the market with premium full-grain leather and minimal edge-to-edge design (absolutely no plastic parts) and copper-plated metal buttons. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off for 9to5 readers on new iPhone 18 Pro models:

  • Minimalist Full-Grain Leather iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (originally $79) Use code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Faux Suede Case (iPhone 18 Pro) $107 (originally $120) Use code 9TO5 at checkout
  • The Modern Faux Suede Case (iPhone 18 Pro) $62 (originally $69)

Arc

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case is here, with new color options this year to match Apple's glacial and wine red phones:

  • Matte Black — $69.99
  • Polished Silver — $89.99
  • Polished Graphite — $99.99
  • Matte Light Blue — $119.99
  • Matte Deep Red — $119.99
  • Polished Gold — $129.99
  • Titanium Stealth Black — $299.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Case $59
  • Colors: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case $59
  • Detachable magnetic back panel design, two modes to switch anytime. With back panel: full-grain leather case, slim design with MagSafe support

Burton Goods

***Note: Use our exclusive code 9TO520 at checkout on the cases below to get an additional 20% off already discounted launch prices. If the code doesn't work, try DUO10.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $60 (originally $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $89 (originally $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo) $60 (originally $80)

Alto Collective — Laser-Engraved Wood

  • Alto Laser-Engraved Wood iPhone 18 Pro Case from $33 (10% off) Use code 9TO5MAC at checkout Engraved Series Retro Inlay Series Custom image upload

UAG

UAG has also launched a series of cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max simultaneously, including their signature rugged models featuring thick corner protection, grippy frames, and multiple drop-protection-focused designs. If you like rough use and care about everyday protection, UAG's product line is definitely worth checking out.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want the usual OtterBox or UAG options, YETI's LoadOut series is worth a look. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop tests for reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you want a more premium but not too bulky case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. Beyond the featured models below, you can also get the ultra-thin Aramid Fiber case designed specifically for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases focus more on design, with futuristic styling, slim cuts, and textured finishes that stand out from other cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

If you're looking for a thinner case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA's products are for you. Their cases typically use lightweight Aramid Fiber, paired with clean minimal aesthetics, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and enhanced protection for the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has multiple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, ranging from slim everyday styles to ultra-rugged designs, covering your needs for reliable protection. Many new models support MagSafe, and some feature grippy sides, accessory holders, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, allowing you to choose based on your desired thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more...

Belkin

Belkin is also a solid choice for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially if you're looking for something cleaner and not as bulky as full-on rugged cases. Their product line typically includes clear and protective cases that support MagSafe, with raised edges for screen and camera protection, and some models (like Protect+) feature reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim looks.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 MagSafe-Compatible Grip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case (with Airbag Impact Corners) $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically releases new iPhone cases quickly, and their iPhone 18 Pro lineup is already available with multiple options. The brand is best known for colorful designs, bold patterns, and protective cases that don't look too dull. Most models in the series support MagSafe, and there are clear, drop-proof, and more stylish options available.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro series follows the brand's signature minimalist design style, focusing on everyday protection. The lineup includes multiple slim, grippy cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models and clear versions that show off the phone's original color. These cases offer good drop protection without making the phone too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more...

elago

elago cases lean towards a simple and sleek design aesthetic, with more affordable pricing compared to other brands. The product line typically includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible options, with clean colors that easily match Apple's original phone tones.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (originally $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (originally $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (originally $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more...

Screen Protectors

  • ZAGG Glass Elite Screen Protector (iPhone 18 Pro) $40
  • TORRAS OrigArmor (iPhone 18 Pro) $35
  • Ailun Screen Protector (iPhone 18 Pro) 3-pack $7
  • ESR Armorite Pro Tempered Glass Screen Protector (2-pack) $30
  • Spigen GlasTR EZ FIT Screen Protector $20
